fields.description: AI provider for the BoQ review AI pass.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Anthropic model id for the AI pass.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Anthropic API key for the BoQ review AI pass. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Anthropic API Key

fields.description: Historical rate matching (DEV2-B1). Model names live ONLY here, never in code: an empty model or price makes matching refuse.
fields.label: Historical matching

fields.description: Both this and Matching enabled must be on for a committed sheet to queue its spec-card job.
fields.label: Make spec cards at commit

fields.description: Anthropic model id for the spec cards. No default.
fields.label: Card model

fields.description: Anthropic model id for the match judge. No default.
fields.label: Judge model

fields.description: Most matching calls in flight at the same time.
fields.label: Calls at once

fields.description: max_tokens sent with every judge call (the judge model reasons before its short reply: DEV2-S8 J10h median 2,583, max 6,496 output tokens).
fields.label: Reply length cap (tokens)

fields.description: max_tokens sent with every spec-card call (20 rows a call).
fields.label: Card reply length cap (tokens)

fields.description: Wait before the one retry of a lone connection error.
fields.label: Retry wait (seconds)

fields.description: This many failed calls within the burst window stop the run.
fields.label: Burst stop: failures

fields.description: A matching request whose input estimate (characters / 2 tokens) is above this is not sent (reason too_large); the run goes on.
fields.label: Largest request (input tokens)

fields.description: USD per million input tokens for the card model. No default: empty = matching refuses.
fields.label: Card model price in (USD / million tokens)

fields.description: USD per million output tokens for the card model. No default: empty = matching refuses.
fields.label: Card model price out (USD / million tokens)

fields.description: USD per million input tokens for the judge model. No default: empty = matching refuses.
fields.label: Judge model price in (USD / million tokens)

fields.description: USD per million output tokens for the judge model. No default: empty = matching refuses.
fields.label: Judge model price out (USD / million tokens)
